facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's Annuaire des statistiques sanitaires 2022, dated July 2023 (figures cover 2022), says health statistics come from the routine health information subsystem (facility reports via zone sanitaire), complemented by subsystems including civil registration (état civil), and that maternal and infant deaths were corrected against the SIMR database.
The Ministry of Health says the 2022 yearbook of health statistics, dated July 2023, is the fifth edition since the framework document for the yearbooks was drawn up.

systems.platform: SNIGS (national health information and management system)

facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's SNIGS published its Annuaire des statistiques sanitaires 2019 in March 2020 (figures for 2019), saying health statistics come from the routine health information subsystem, with monthly paper reports from health facilities entered in DHIS2 by health zone, complemented by subsystems including civil registration (etat civil).
The yearbook for 2019, dated March 2020, calls itself the second edition after the framework document for the health statistics yearbooks was drawn up.

INStaD published its yearbook of civil-status statistics for 2024 (births, marriages, deaths for all 77 communes, e.g. 468,570 births registered, 3,228 marriages, 9,707 deaths), compiled from the civil-registration database of ANIP; the figures cover 2024 and the yearbook is dated November 2025.
